title: Computation of damping aerodynamic coefficients about a 3D hypersonic vehicle.
author: Danilo Mayer Oliveira
abstract: FAST is a computational tool developed by SUPAERO and ONERA with the objective of being capable of calculating aerothermodynamic properties for hypersonic 3D vehicles in a quick way, for preliminary analysis. During the years, the code is improved, in a way to achieve more accurate results and to expand the application of the code. This work presents a method implemented in FAST to compute the effects of angular velocities in the computation of forces and moments.
